However, some real bandages have manufacturing codes or brand marks, so this is a minor suspicion rather than a definitive failure.

In a high-resolution macro shot, one might expect a sharper occlusion boundary or slight shadowing/lifting at the edges. The current rendering looks slightly 'painted on' rather than physically adhered.
